methodology.title: Election equipment catalog evidence policy
methodology.description: The pilot records what an official source actually establishes and keeps certified configurations, state approvals, jurisdiction deployment observations, historical configuration changes, and unknown field details in separate scopes.
methodology.caveat: An EAC engineering change order documents an approved change to one or more certified configurations. It does not establish that a particular jurisdiction installed the change, and a VSTL record is not a unit-level service or repair history.

sources.title: OptiPlex 5250 All-in-One Technical Specifications
sources.caveat: The manufacturer sheet describes the OptiPlex 5250 product family and its configurable options. Pro V&V separately identifies that model as a ClearAccess option; the sheet does not establish the exact processor, memory, storage, wireless option, or port occupation of a certified or fielded ClearAccess unit.

sources.title: DS200 Poll Place Scanner and Tabulator One-Sheet
sources.caveat: The manufacturer one-sheet supports the DS200 external appearance and named features, including battery backup. It is not a dimensional drawing, component bill of materials, certified version record, or source for the battery manufacturer, capacity, runtime, or internal component placement.

sources.title: ClearAccess official product reference image
sources.caveat: The official image supports a portrait Elo touchscreen, headphones, and accessible keypad as an external appearance reference only. It does not show the full certified component set, internal placement, ports, printer, UPS, or dimensional scale.

sources.publisher: Colorado Secretary of State; Avalue Technology, Inc.
sources.title: Avalue SID-21V-Z37-A1R User Manual
sources.caveat: The manual documents the Avalue SID-21V-Z37-A1R COTS hardware family used as an ImageCast X option. Its Android 4.4 example environment is not the certified Democracy Suite 5.17 software environment, and optional hardware in the manual is not assumed installed in every certified or fielded unit.

sources.title: Democracy Suite ImageCast X System Maintenance Manual 5.17-CO::4

sources.title: ImageCast X Touch Screen Responsiveness Product Advisory Notice

sources.title: MultiTech Security Advisories
sources.pageOrSection: Security-advisory index and linked advisory list
sources.caveat: This is a point-in-time manufacturer index. Its absence of an exact model is not proof that the product has no vulnerability, and later advisories may change the result.

revisions.pageOrSection: Security-advisory index and linked advisory list

sources.title: MultiTech security advisories linked from the reviewed index
sources.pageOrSection: Nine linked advisory PDFs covering ten CVEs; applicable-product tables and not-affected determinations
sources.caveat: The reviewed advisories either identify other MultiTech product families or state that MultiTech products are not affected. None expressly identifies MTSMC-C2, MTSMC-LVW3, CE910, or LE910. This exclusion is bounded to the archived advisory set and does not establish that those modem families are vulnerability-free.

revisions.pageOrSection: Nine linked advisory PDFs covering ten CVEs; applicable-product tables and not-affected determinations

sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology, National Vulnerability Database
sources.title: NVD CVE API exact-product modem query responses
sources.pageOrSection: Eleven CVE API 2.0 keyword responses for exact model and radio-module aliases
sources.caveat: Every archived query returned zero keyword matches at review time. NVD keyword matching is not a complete product security assessment and cannot rule out unindexed, differently named, undisclosed, or firmware-dependent vulnerabilities.

revisions.pageOrSection: Eleven CVE API 2.0 keyword responses for exact model and radio-module aliases

sources.title: Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog
sources.caveat: No reviewed catalog record matched MultiTech, Telit, SocketModem, MTSMC, or LE910 terms. KEV contains vulnerabilities known to be exploited in the wild; absence from KEV does not mean a product has no vulnerabilities or that exploitation has never occurred.

The Pro V&V table does not identify the DS200 modem ordering revision, so this current family mapping is not proof of the radio module or firmware installed in the historically evaluated units.

sources.title: Democracy Suite System Overview 5.17-CO::3
sources.caveat: This vendor-authored Colorado technical-data document describes Democracy Suite 5.17-CO. Its own disclaimer excludes modem and transmission functionality from that certification campaign, and its high-level diagram warns that not every depicted component applies to every jurisdiction. It does not establish a field installation or live network configuration.

sources.title: Protecting Elections: Security
sources.caveat: The current manufacturer page states a product-wide security policy for certified Clear Ballot products. It does not identify the wiring, switch configuration, enabled interfaces, or deployment state of a particular ClearAccess or ClearCount unit and is not substituted for the exact ClearVote 2.5 certification record.

editorialPolicy.changedSourceRule: A changed archived artifact requires claim review; a hash change alone is not an equipment change.
editorialPolicy.fieldedVersionRule: A fielded version requires a dated official jurisdiction inventory, acceptance, inspection, or equivalent direct record.
